topics.title: Dynamic Typing, Control Flow & String Manipulation
topics.objective: Understand Python indentation semantics, f-strings, conditional blocks, and loop iterations.
topics.example: for idx, item in enumerate(items): print(f"{idx}: {item}")
topics.exercise: Build a word-count analysis script that processes text and outputs frequency tables.

topics.title: Lists, Dictionaries, Sets & Comprehensions
topics.objective: Master idiomatic list and dictionary comprehensions and set membership operations.
topics.example: squares = [x**2 for x in range(10) if x % 2 == 0]
topics.exercise: Write a data deduplication and group-by utility for CSV records using dictionaries.

topics.title: First-Class Functions, *args, **kwargs & Decorators
topics.objective: Design modular functions, closure scopes, and functional execution wrappers.
topics.example: def timer(func): def wrapper(*args, **kwargs): return func(*args, **kwargs); return wrapper
topics.exercise: Create a memoization decorator that caches expensive function returns in memory.

topics.title: Object-Oriented Programming & Dunder Methods
topics.objective: Construct classes with __init__, __str__, __repr__, and property decorators.
topics.example: class Account: def __init__(self, balance: float): self._balance = balance
topics.exercise: Design an inventory management class hierarchy with stock update constraints.

topics.title: Virtual Environments, Packaging & File I/O
topics.objective: Organize multi-file packages, manage pyproject.toml dependencies, and perform safe file operations.
topics.example: with open("data.json", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f: data = json.load(f)
topics.exercise: Build a modular CLI expense tracker that saves and loads transactions from JSON files.
